modules.reason: The module had no tests. New runs pin HTTPS only, TLS 1.2, the managed identity, the build revision app setting and the storage role assignment scope. The external build-info script is overridden so it never runs in tests.
Only a description changed. The existing runs creates_one_subnet_and_nsg_per_key and names_follow_the_convention still cover the module.

findings.title: FTP deployment is allowed on the function app
findings.detail: site_config sets ftps_state to AllAllowed, so plain FTP and FTPS uploads are both accepted. Credentials and code can travel unencrypted.
findings.suggestion: Set ftps_state to Disabled, or FtpsOnly if FTP deployment is really needed.
